data.one_liner: Export Syncfusion Flutter DataGrid content to Excel and PDF formats
data.what_it_does: The Syncfusion Flutter DataGrid Export library allows developers to export DataGrid contents such as headers, rows, stacked headers, and table summary rows into Excel and PDF formats with various customization options. It integrates with a GlobalKey attached to the SfDataGrid widget to trigger export methods.
use_when: You need to export tabular data displayed in a Syncfusion DataGrid to Excel spreadsheets or PDF documents.
Your application requires generating reports or downloadable files from grid content.
avoid_when: You are not using the Syncfusion Flutter DataGrid widget.
You need to export standard Flutter tables or widgets other than SfDataGrid.
strengths: Supports exporting headers, rows, stacked headers, and table summary rows.
Provides direct methods to output to both Excel workbooks and PDF documents.
weaknesses: Commercial package requiring a Syncfusion commercial or Community License.
Strictly tied to the syncfusion_flutter_datagrid package.
data.setup_notes: Requires a valid Syncfusion commercial license or free Community License. Import syncfusion_flutter_datagrid_export/export.dart and attach a GlobalKey<SfDataGridState> to the SfDataGrid widget.
